steps.title: Opening GitHub issues page for browser-use/browser-use
Taking snapshot of GitHub issues page
steps.code:
var snap = await page.snapshot()
console.log(snap.snapshot.outline())

steps.title: Filtering issues by the bug label
steps.code:
// Clear the search field and type the filtered query
await page.click({ ref: "e245" })
await wait({ waitTime: 0.5 })
// Type the query to filter for open bugs
await page.type({ ref: "e245", text: "is:issue is:open label:bug", clear: true })
await wait({ waitTime: 0.5 })
await page.press({ key: "Enter" })
await wait({ waitTime: 2 })
steps.rationale: I can see the issues page. I need to filter by the "bug" label. Let me use the search box to refine the query.
